Price snapshot (approx. $ per 1M tokens, normalized for generation-heavy workloads):
- OpenAI (API): ~$18 / 1M (published conversational/generation variants; varies by model family)
- Anthropic (API): ~$16 / 1M (similar family-dependent variance)

- Committed pricing assumes a reserved capacity plan (Dedicated) with predictable throughput and a 30–45 day canary rollout; this enables our $8/1M floor for the 12‑month term.
- We can include a one-month pilot credit (offsetting ~25% of pilot invoice) if Lumina signs an LOI to progress to a committed capacity evaluation within 60 days.

If that pricing ladder lines up with procurement’s expectations (pilot $12/1M vs your stated $15 max), I’ll draft the formal pilot quote and loop Legal for a short SOW/LOI. Also attaching the SOC 2 summary in the next message.
